remarks: Experience the perfect blend of charm and sophistication in this beautifully updated Nantucket-style Colonial, located within the Tokeneke Association. Originally built in 1921, this home has been thoughtfully expanded and renovated, preserving its classic architecture while introducing contemporary comfort and style. Perched on a naturally elevated lot, the home enjoys sweeping views of Scott's Cove Estuary. Inside, you'll find high ceilings on every floor and well-designed living space that invites effortless everyday living.The main floor offers a seamless flow from the living room to the elegant dining room, which features a custom-built wet bar. The kitchen includes a cozy breakfast nook and opens to the adjacent family room, where new built-in cabinetry, a wood-burning fireplace, and French doors lead to a spacious wraparound deck with spectacular water views and professionally landscaped grounds. Upstairs, the primary suite offers two walk-in closets and a spacious bath. Three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a charming converted sleeping porch-now a tranquil reading nook or study-complete the second level.The third floor provides even more flexibility, featuring a guest bedroom, full bath, playroom or gym, and an additional office, offering ideal space for an au-pair, guests, or multifunctional needs. A newly constructed two-car garage enhances the property with ample storage and convenience. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Darien!
